body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy or unattended obstacle within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, push an enemy 2 units and suppress its ordinary benefit from the cover it leaves until the start of your next turn. An unattended light obstacle instead moves 2 units without opposition.

surges.html: Deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage to a hit enemy, or 2 to an unattended obstacle.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Golem
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Golem Full Manifestation (FM-1G). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
